raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With EAGLE v2 MTP, DP attention and a DSA model (GLM-5.2, `index_share_for_mtp_iteration=true`), the decode worker crashes
with `Memory access fault by GPU node-N ... Reason: Unknown` after 20-100 minutes of load. The faulting kernel is the
DSA top-k (`coop_topk_kernel<2048,...>`) called from `Indexer._forward_cuda_k_only` on an `IDLE` batch.

Chain (file references are upstream main):

1. When a DP rank sees a batch that cannot use CUDA graphs (with index sharing, a batch without a DSA seed sets
   `EagleDraftInput.cuda_graph_compatible = False`), `dp_attn._spec_input_cuda_graph_compatible` min-reduces this over
   DP and every rank runs eager, including padded `IDLE` ranks.
2. `EAGLEWorkerV2._draft_forward_idle` (`eagle_worker_v2.py:881`) runs each draft step under
   `ForwardContext(attn_backend=draft_attn_backend.attn_backends[i])`.
3. `EagerRunner._execute_idle` re-initializes only `model_runner.attn_backend`. For the draft runner that is the
   draft-extend backend, not `attn_backends[i]`.
4. Layers read the forward-context backend, so the DSA indexer sees the `forward_metadata` of an earlier real batch.
   `_should_skip_logits_computation` takes the k-only path, which builds `index_topk`-wide (2048) dummy logits and ranks
   them with the stale lengths (~1e5 in our dumps). The kernel reads past the row: a GPU fault when the next page is
   unmapped, silent garbage otherwise.

## Modifications

In `EagerRunner._execute_idle` (bs > 0), after `model_runner.attn_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)`, also
init the active forward-context backend when it is a different object. This adds 7 lines and no new import. The
behaviour is unchanged when the two backends are the same object, which covers every non-draft runner.

Unit test `test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_eager_idle_active_backend.py` (CPU):
- the context backend differs → both backends are initialized. This test fails without the fix.
- the same backend → initialized once.
- bs = 0 → no init.

Open points for reviewers:
- The fix lives in `EagerRunner`, which is the one place that knows both the runner backend and the active context.
  An alternative is for `_draft_forward_idle` to init `attn_backends[i]` itself.
- On the `bs == 0` branch only `model_runner.attn_backend.forward_metadata` is cleared; this PR does not change that.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change only affects metadata of padded IDLE batches, whose outputs are discarded.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Validated on the equivalent patch applied to an sglang v0.5.21-based tree. Setup: GLM-5.2-MXFP4, 1P1D on one MI355X
node (P TP4, D TP4/DP4 + DP attention), EAGLE MTP, `index_share_for_mtp_iteration=true`, multi-turn agent workload at
concurrency 56.

| run | fix | result |
|---|---|---|
| 5+ runs | no | GPU memory access fault after 23-100 min each |
| 2 runs with an instrumented top-k call site | no | 12 and 20 out-of-row top-k calls in ~15-20 min, all on `ForwardMode.IDLE` with stale metadata |
| 1 run, same instrumentation | yes | full ~88 min benchmark, 0 bad calls, 0 faults |
| 1 run, no instrumentation | yes | ~170 min, 0 faults; benchmark score 21814 vs 22045 with `index_share=false` on the same node |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort, ruff check, ruff format, codespell)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
Closing this later duplicate in favor of #45156, which was opened earlier and fixes the same active-attention-backend initialization defect, including empty-batch cleanup. I compared the implementations with current main (`e4d4a9a7de`) and contributed our AMD failure diagnosis and isolated validation run IDs there.

The historical deployment used simulated MTP acceptance, so its fault-free runs are not generated-text correctness evidence, and the throughput figures in this original description should not be read as the effect of this patch. No new GPU validation was performed during this consolidation. The CI failures here are PR-gate failures due to the missing `run-ci` label, not executed regression-test failures.

detail.title: [Fix] spec: init the active attention backend for eager IDLE batches

files.patch:
@@ -452,6 +452,13 @@ def _execute_idle(
             if not self.enable_pdmux:
                 forward_batch = self.load_batch(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
             model_runner.attn_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)
+            # Layers read the ForwardContext backend, which can differ from
+            # model_runner.attn_backend (EAGLE v2 idle draft steps run under the
+            # per-step decode backend); init it too so it does not keep a
+            # previous batch's forward_metadata.
+            active_backend = get_forward_context().attn_backend
+            if active_backend is not model_runner.attn_backend:
+                active_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)
         else:
             model_runner.attn_backend.forward_metadata = None

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+"""EagerRunner._execute_idle must init the active forward-context backend.
+
+The EAGLE draft idle loop runs each step under a ForwardContext whose
+attn_backend is the per-step decode backend, while the draft runner's
+model_runner.attn_backend is the draft-extend backend. Layers read the active
+context backend, so it has to get forward_metadata for the idle batch too.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import (
+    ForwardContext,
+    forward_context,
+    get_attn_backend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.eager_runner import EagerRunner
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _make_runner(runner_backend):
+    seen = {}
+
+    def _model_forward(input_ids, positions, forward_batch, **kwargs):
+        # Record the backend the layers would read during the forward.
+        seen["backend"] = get_attn_backend()
+        return "out"
+
+    model_runner = SimpleNamespace(
+        attn_backend=runner_backend,
+        device_timer=None,
+        model=SimpleNamespace(forward=_model_forward),
+        _pp_kwargs=lambda pp_proxy_tensors: {},
+    )
+    runner = EagerRunner.__new__(EagerRunner)
+    runner.model_runner = model_runner
+    runner.enable_pdmux = False
+    runner.load_batch = lambda forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors=None: forward_batch
+    return runner, seen
+
+
+def _idle_batch(batch_size):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.IDLE,
+        batch_size=batch_size,
+        input_ids=None,
+        positions=None,
+        moe_num_token_non_padded=None,
+    )
+
+
+class TestEagerIdleActiveBackend(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_context_backend_differs_from_runner_backend(self):
+        draft_extend_backend = MagicMock(name="draft_extend_backend")
+        step_backend = MagicMock(name="step_backend")
+        runner, seen = _make_runner(draft_extend_backend)
+        batch = _idle_batch(batch_size=1)
+
+        with forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=step_backend)):
+            out = runner._execute_idle(batch)
+
+        self.assertEqual(out, "out")
+        self.assertIs(seen["backend"], step_backend)
+        draft_extend_backend.init_forward_metadata.assert_called_once_with(batch)
+        step_backend.init_forward_metadata.assert_called_once_with(batch)
+
+    def test_context_backend_is_runner_backend(self):
+        backend = MagicMock(name="backend")
+        runner, seen = _make_runner(backend)
+        batch = _idle_batch(batch_size=1)
+
+        with forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=backend)):
+            runner._execute_idle(batch)
+
+        self.assertIs(seen["backend"], backend)
+        backend.init_forward_metadata.assert_called_once_with(batch)
+
+    def test_empty_idle_batch_does_not_init_metadata(self):
+        draft_extend_backend = MagicMock(name="draft_extend_backend")
+        step_backend = MagicMock(name="step_backend")
+        runner, _ = _make_runner(draft_extend_backend)
+
+        with forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=step_backend)):
+            runner._execute_idle(_idle_batch(batch_size=0))
+
+        draft_extend_backend.init_forward_metadata.assert_not_called()
+        step_backend.init_forward_metadata.assert_not_called()
+        self.assertIsNone(draft_extend_backend.forward_metadata)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
